target_text:
// K data indexed by [token][head element]. For a VNNI slot use set_k_row /
  // get_k_row below (Note [K VNNI storage]).
body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

'Not available for VNNI slots' restates the requires clause !k_vnni::layout_on<head_size> (Rule 3 prefers the clause over a comment), and ': one contiguous row per token' restates the 2-D view the function returns. The one fact the code does not say is where a VNNI slot's rows go, so only that pointer stays.

Proposed:
```cpp
  // K data indexed by [token][head element]. For a VNNI slot use set_k_row /
  // get_k_row below (Note [K VNNI storage]).
```
